messages:
Ben (AE): New POC with Verdant Health. They want to test a custom variant of open-13b + a quant 6b for embeddings. Need checklist + hosted vs dedicated pricing.
Rina (Solutions Eng): Noted. Quick tech checks: tokenizer parity, kv-cache compatibility, embedding dim for the 6b.
Carlos (SRE): Infra note: 13b fp16 -> A10 preferred; 6b q4_0 ok on T4. Peak they gave: 30 rps, avg 150 tokens.
Jules (Security): They sent a security questionnaire. Main asks: BYOK, audit logs, EU-only processing for PHI. I'll draft answers.
Ava (Product): Also confirm rollout: canary + auto rollback, and eval hooks for quality.
Ben (AE): Customer wants a 2-week POC starting Monday. Feasible?
Rina (Solutions Eng): If artifacts arrive by Thu, we can sandbox in ~48h. Dedicated trial adds ~4 business days for provisioning.
Carlos (SRE): I'll prepare autoscale policy and sizing for reserved pool.
Jules (Security): Recommend Private if they insist on strict EU residency. Dedicated supports CMK.
Ben (AE): Action items: 1) @Rina tech checklist + variant mapping (ETA Fri) 2) @Jules questionnaire answers (ETA Thu) 3) @Carlos sizing + lead times (ETA Thu) 4) @Ava POC success criteria blurb (ETA Fri).
Rina (Solutions Eng): I'll include a small models.json snippet and mapping template in follow-up.
Ben (AE): Thanks team, I'll ask Verdant for artifacts and eval set today.
